set system host-name DeviceC.explanation: Configure the host name of the device.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: The host name of the equipment is used to identify the equipment in the network.

parameters.name: lsr-id
parameters.explanation: LSR ID, usually the ring address of the device.

set protocols mpls segment-routing.explanation: Enables the MPLS section route function.

set protocols mpls segment-routing globa.explanation: Configure the global block range for the MPLS section route.

parameters.name: start-label
parameters.explanation: The starting label value of the global block.

parameters.name: end-label
parameters.explanation: The end label value of the global block.

set protocols isis level 1.explanation: Configure the level of the ISIS protocol.

parameters.name: level
parameters.explanation: Level of IS-IS agreement, e.g. 2.

set protocols isis system-id 49.0000.000.explanation: Configure the system ID of the IS-IS protocol.

parameters.name: system-id
parameters.explanation: IS-IS protocol system ID to identify equipment in the network.

set protocols isis metric-style wide.explanation: Configure the measurement style of the IS-IS protocol.

parameters.name: metric-style
parameters.explanation: The measurement style of the IS-IS protocol, the wide style of the measurement style.

set protocols isis interface ge-0/0/0.explanation: Enables an IS-IS protocol on the specified interface.

parameters.name: interface
